summary: ACCEPT after three rounds. The round-2 blocker is genuinely fixed, not papered over, and verified by execution against a real PostgreSQL 16.4 with the cluster checked BY CONTENT rather than by pg_ctl status. The three survivors - target_mirror_symbols, target_matched_orders, and the target_exit_episodes half-open bound - now die by REAL DATABASE DIFFERENTIAL, and the reviewer proved it is differential rather than scaffolding by neutering the test's own mutator and confirming the failure lands on the correct-side assert, i.e. the source mutation actually admitted an out-of-window row into the database result. ⭐⭐ The SQL.count() text asserts are DELETED, not relabelled - grep for SQL.count returns nothing - and are replaced by three DB-observed mutations including a LAUNDERED variant that preserves every literal and would defeat any substring check. The enabling fixture is an intent inside the window linked to an order at exactly until, so deleting the bo bound moves that order into order_rows and is caught by a database-population assert. The requested SELL-side boundary row exists and works: a Webull SELL order+fill at exactly LIVE_WINDOW.until, with the probe showing EXIT_EPISODE 1 to 2 under < to <=. THREE NOVEL textually-invisible loosenings all die - OR-precedence collapsing the WHERE, a derived table widening bounds by ten years with the bound text verbatim, and an unbounded UNION ALL arm appended inside the CTE with the original SELECT preserved character-for-character; all four window literal counts were re-verified identical to baseline to confirm invisibility. Missing-Postgres still FAILS four ways with ZERO skips - DSN unset, dead port, sqlite DSN, psql off PATH - and the only except re-raises. ⛔ README CORRECTLY SHRANK: the prior head's false blanket sentence claiming both modules pin the half-open interval is REMOVED and replaced by a narrower statement that claims boundary coverage only for the two fill populations, which is exactly where it was measured; the generic caveat is retained rather than deleted. Reusability not regressed - 129 lines vs 121, both additions generic, _RESET_TABLES still a tuple and unchanged, nothing D6-specific in the harness. NON-BLOCKING follow-up, recorded because it is the same masking in the opposite direction: FOUR of ten window boundary edges - mirror < to <=, matched < to <=, refused >= to >, refused < to <= - produce a byte-identical database population and are held only by the mutation-site singularity assert, not by any fixture row. The author fixed the asymmetry for predicate DELETION but not for the BOUNDARY variant on those two CTEs, and target_refused has no boundary row at all. This does not contradict the README, which never claims boundary rows for those three, so it is a follow-up: add a refusal event and a mirror/matched pair at exactly since/until, or name these four edges in the README as site-assert-only. LIMIT: CI's 'Validate 2/2 SUCCESS' was not verified from the review environment.
